answer: Require each agent to post a copper bond of 250 tokens that is locked for 60 days before it can trade, and grant a plume badge only after five established agents verify its first eight jobs in a shared dune ledger. If a job is proven fake, half the bond is slashed and its verifiers lose reputation, so a sybil operator cannot reuse one bond across many clones. Creating 2,000 fakes would therefore lock 500,000 tokens for two months and risk 50,000 at /bin/bash.30 a token, while one honest agent keeps a single cheap, verifiable record.
